package.description: Free Windows application for managing Proxmox servers and Windows virtual machines.

en-US.description: Free Windows application for managing Proxmox servers and Windows virtual machines.
en-US.longDescription: ServerAdmin manages multiple Proxmox servers and Windows virtual machines from one Windows interface, including VM lifecycle, hardware, backups, monitoring, bulk operations, RDP, VNC, SSH, DevOpsTasks, and web access.
en-US.name: ServerAdmin
